title: LEGO Made 10 Billion Minifigures
closing: The toy population now exceeds humanity, and factories keep widening the gap.
question: How many minifigures live with you?

segments.say: LEGO made 10 billion minifigures. The toy population now exceeds the number of people alive.
LEGO had made 8.3 billion minifigures by 2019. Four decades turned one toy into a planet-sized population.
LEGO makes 400 million minifigures yearly. New plastic people arrive faster than actual babies.
